note: First live-method prototype. Events surfaced by a balanced regional sweep, each included ONLY because it matched a pre-committed catalog indicator and cleared the sourcing bar. 'status' records whether the action stood or was checked (blocked/reversed) -- a live-phase addition surfaced by this run. 'parallels' lists historical figures in data/figures that triggered the same indicator. This is R&D data, not yet a shipped surface.

events.title: Texas mid-decade congressional gerrymander
events.note: Signed 29 Aug 2025; redrew five Democratic-held (largely minority) districts to add up to five Republican seats; a federal court called it a racial gerrymander before the Supreme Court let it be used.

sources.title: Gov. Greg Abbott signs new Texas GOP congressional map
Supreme Court lets Texas use gerrymandered map

events.title: California Prop 50 partisan gerrymander
events.note: Voters approved Prop 50 (65-35) on 4 Nov 2025, suspending the independent redistricting commission to impose a Democratic-drawn map favoring five seats, explicitly to offset Texas.

sources.title: Proposition 50 — Legislative Analyst's Office
California voters approve Prop. 50

events.title: Attempt to federalize National Guard over state objection
events.note: Early Oct 2025 move to federalize and deploy the National Guard to Chicago over Illinois's objection; a TRO (9 Oct) then the Supreme Court (23 Dec 2025) kept it blocked, finding no legal authority. The action was attempted and judicially reversed.

sources.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump's bid to deploy National Guard in Illinois
Supreme Court rejects Trump's effort to deploy National Guard in Illinois

events.title: Sitting federal judiciary replaced via elections
events.actor: Morena supermajority & Pres. Claudia Sheinbaum (constitutional reform)
events.note: A constitutional amendment ended fixed tenure for all sitting federal judges and subjected every judgeship to popular election; a reconstituted Supreme Court took office 1 Sep 2025. Mechanism was amendment + a ~13%-turnout popular vote, so 'to shape outcomes' is partly interpretive -- flagged medium.

sources.title: Mexico: Electoral Process Undermines Judicial Independence
A Timeline of Mexico's Judicial Reform and Elections

events.title: Palestine Action proscribed; mass protest arrests
events.note: On 5 Jul 2025 Palestine Action was banned under the Terrorism Act 2000, criminalizing support; 3,000+ arrested at sit-ins by Apr 2026. The UN human-rights chief called it a misuse of counter-terror law.

sources.title: UK: Palestine Action ban 'disturbing' misuse of counter-terrorism legislation
What is Palestine Action, the group linked to hundreds of arrests?

events.title: Police detain anti-government protesters
events.actor: Interior Ministry / police (SNS govt under Vučić)
events.note: Around the Novi Sad disaster anniversary, police detained scores of protesters (37 in Belgrade on 2 Nov 2025; ~79 in related actions) at gatherings labelled 'unregistered.'

sources.title: Dozens Arrested in Serbia as Govt Supporters and Protesters Clash
Serbian police detain 79 protesters as dissent persists

events.title: Foreign-funding 'transparency' law on NGOs
events.note: In force June 2025, imposing disclosure duties on foreign-funded NGOs; the culture ministry has used it to exclude rights groups from public funding. No historical parallel in our set -- a modern civil-society instrument.

sources.title: Slovak Civil Society Fears Chilling New Era as NGO Law Is Implemented
Opinion on the amendments to the Slovakia NGO laws

events.title: Jailed Istanbul mayor İmamoğlu convicted
events.note: CHP presidential candidate Ekrem İmamoğlu, jailed since 23 Mar 2025, was convicted 16 Jul 2025 of insulting/threatening an official; a 400-defendant corruption trial opened March 2026.

sources.title: Turkish court convicts jailed Istanbul mayor and Erdogan rival
Türkiye: Leading Opponent of Erdoğan on Trial

events.title: Military shuts largest independent media house
events.note: NMG-Uganda's print and broadcast outlets were shuttered 28 Jun 2026 and digital platforms suspended 1 Jul; journalist Timothy Kalyegira charged with unlicensed operation. Echoes Amin's own 1976 ban of Munno in the same country.

sources.title: 'Press freedom is dead': 2 journalists detained in Ugandan media crackdown
Uganda: Military Seizing Government Critics

events.title: Awami League barred from elections
events.note: On 13 May 2025 the EC suspended the Awami League's registration, barring the party of ousted PM Sheikh Hasina from the Feb 2026 election, days after the interim government banned its activities under the amended Anti-Terrorism Act.

sources.title: Bangladesh's interim government bans Awami League from contesting elections
Bangladesh Election Commission suspends Awami League registration

events.title: Opposition leader Chebbi jailed on appeal
events.note: On 28 Nov 2025 the Tunis Court of Appeal upheld 'conspiracy against state security' convictions; police arrested opposition leader Ahmed Nejib Chebbi on 4 Dec 2025 to enforce a 12-year sentence.

sources.title: Tunisia arrests top opposition leader Nejib Chebbi in widening crackdown
Tunisia: Prominent Activists Held in 'Conspiracy Case'

events.title: Regulator pulls JamiiForums license before election
events.note: On 6 Sep 2025 the TCRA suspended JamiiForums' license for 90 days and blocked access, weeks before the 29 Oct election, citing content that allegedly 'misleads the public' and defames the president.

sources.title: Tanzanian authorities suspend online forum for 90 days, weeks ahead of election
TCRA suspends JamiiForums licence

events.title: Indefinite presidential re-election enacted
events.actor: Legislative Assembly (Nuevas Ideas) & Pres. Nayib Bukele
events.note: On 31 Jul 2025 the Bukele-aligned Assembly approved (57-3) a reform allowing indefinite presidential re-election, extending terms to six years and eliminating the run-off. Same indicator Perón triggered in 1949.

sources.title: El Salvador approves indefinite presidential reelection and extends terms to 6 years
El Salvador approves indefinite presidential re-election

events.title: Reissued emergency decrees a court had struck down
events.note: After the Constitutional Court repeatedly annulled his state-of-emergency decrees, Noboa issued materially similar decrees (incl. a new 60-day emergency across 10 provinces, June 2026), which monitors documented as defying binding rulings. Same indicator Amin triggered by defying CJ Kiwanuka's writ.

sources.title: World Report 2026: Ecuador
Constitutional Court of Ecuador Annuls Again State of Emergency

events.title: Mass revocation of lawyers' licenses
events.note: In July 2026 the Supreme Court stripped practice licenses from large numbers of lawyers without notice, including exiled dissidents and rights defenders; a UN expert called it a 'purge of the legal profession.' Prompted adding indicator rol-09 (professional-license purge) -- an example of the live phase feeding catalog improvements.

sources.title: Nicaragua strips lawyers of certification in latest crackdown on dissent
World Report 2026: Nicaragua

excluded.item: Georgia jailing of journalist Mzia Amaghlobeli
excluded.reason: The charged conduct was assaulting an officer, not reporting; mapping to prs-03 would require inferring motive.

excluded.item: Argentina courts strike down Milei emergency decrees
excluded.reason: Independent courts annulled the decrees and the executive OBEYED -- checks functioned; no defiance, so no rol-02 match. Contrast with Ecuador, where the executive reissued after being struck.
A foreign military action, not a domestic governance act against the country's own institutions.
